# Import and export script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## transfer.export

Packs actions, commands and timers into one import text (starting with CUEBOT1:) that you can share. Fails when a name is not found.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | `actions` | Optional. Action names, separated by commas, like "Shoutout, Raid alert". |
| `commands` | `commands` | Optional. Command names, separated by commas, like "!so, !lurk". |
| `timers` | `timers` | Optional. Timer names, separated by commas. |
| `includeDependencies` | `include_dependencies` | Optional. true (the default) also packs what they need, like actions they run. false packs only what you named. |
| `name` | `name` | Optional. A name for the pack, shown when someone imports it. |
| `author` | `author` | Optional. Your name, shown when someone imports it. |
| `description` | `description` | Optional. A short note about the pack, shown when someone imports it. |

**Gives back:** The import text, starting with CUEBOT1:.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("transfer.export", new { actions = "Shoutout, Raid alert", name = "My shoutout pack", author = "CoolStreamer" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.transfer_export(actions="Shoutout, Raid alert", name="My shoutout pack", author="CoolStreamer")
    ```
